question: Which of the following applicaons of a vapour compression system is a type of refrigerated cabinet that displays merchandise as well as cools it?
solution:
The correct answer is __Visible cooler.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A visible cooler is a type of refrigerated cabinet used for displaying merchandise while keeping it cool.
 
• It is commonly used in retail stores and supermarkets for products such as beverages, dairy items, and packaged foods.
 
• The design typically includes transparent doors or panels for easy visibility of the contents.
 
• Visible coolers are equipped with a vapour compression refrigeration system that maintains a consistent low temperature.
 
• This system is energy efficient and ensures the merchandise stays fresh and in optimal condition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deep Freezer:**

 
 
• Designed for storing food at extremely low temperatures for long durations.
 
• Typically used for frozen goods, not for merchandise display.
 
 
 
• **Water Cooler:**
 
 
• Primarily used to cool and dispense drinking water.
 
• Not intended for merchandise display or storage.
 
 
 
• **Bottle Cooler:**
 
 
• Used for cooling bottled beverages, often in bars or restaurants.
 
• Not typically designed for merchandise display.
